checks_run.expected: Every mutation keeps its authorization, validation, optimistic concurrency and audit. No new injection, IDOR, privilege escalation or portability issue is introduced.
checks_run.actual: No new defect found. The guard trigger runs as the caller with search_path pinned, uses no dynamic SQL, and mth_app cannot alter or disable it. The API takes the hierarchy lock before its FOR UPDATE row lock, so its own path does not deadlock with the trigger. Destination authorization precedes the cycle and depth checks, and the If-Match version check is unchanged. The rate-limit subject map only grows from validated sessions, is bounded, and stores hashed keys. Observations, not findings: (a) within one organization, an out-of-scope existing unit gives 403 while a nonexistent ID gives 422; with UUIDv7 IDs (74 random bits) this is not a practical enumeration oracle, and organizations remain indistinguishable. (b) A direct-SQL writer can deadlock against the trigger (40P01), which fails closed. (c) The REPEATABLE READ depth-only residual is stated in the migration header.
